tools.name: agent_send_email
tools.description: Sends one e-mail on behalf of an autonomous agent to one or more recipients, compiling a Markdown body into responsive HTML at the edge, with an optional reply-to so answers reach a human. tools.name: agent_preview_email
tools.description: Runs the full validation and Markdown-to-HTML compilation of an e-mail without sending anything: checks every recipient address and the subject, compiles the body and returns the recipient list and the compiled size, with status 'preview_compiled'. Use it before agent_send_email when an agent is uns

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_send_email, agent_preview_email · Private data: agent_send_email · Public sink: agent_send_email, agent_preview_email · Destructive: agent_send_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_send_email, agent_preview_email · Private data: agent_send_email · Public sink: agent_send_email, agent_preview_email · Destructive: agent_send_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "agent_send_email" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
